information:
Português
É necessário ter lido as regras da WCA (acompanhe a aba GUIA DO COMPETIDOR).

Após a data de 09/09/2024 as inscrições e pagamentos serão suspensos e somente abertos para o dia do evento as 7h da manha ate as 8h do mesmo dia. Impreterivelmente.

**(A entrada para o público é livre.)**


English
It is necessary to read the WCA rules (follow the COMPETITOR GUIDE tab).

After the date of 09/09/2024, registrations and payments will be suspended and will only be open on the day of the event from 7 am until 8 am on the same day. Unpreventably.

**(Admission to the public is free.)**
